classes.name: British Superbike
classes.notes: 1000cc production-based superbike; control tyre Pirelli (confirmed 2025). 6 constructors: Aprilia, BMW, Ducati, Honda, Kawasaki, Yamaha.

classes.name: British Supersport (Next Generation)
classes.notes: 600cc production-based; Next Generation regulations adopted 2025 onward.

classes.name: National Superstock 1000
classes.notes: 1000cc near-stock superbike; traditional BSB feeder class.

classes.name: British Talent Cup
classes.notes: Junior pathway; 300-400cc machines; riders must meet age/experience criteria.

classes.name: BMW Motorrad Cup
classes.notes: One-make BMW S1000RR; spec machine and tyre package.

classes.name: National Sportbike
classes.notes: Entry-level national production sportbike class on BSB support bill.

classes.name: Kawasaki British Superteen
classes.notes: Junior class; Kawasaki Ninja 400; age-gated pathway for young riders.

classes.name: Clubman Superstock 600 / 1000
classes.notes: Core ACU club race class; production sportbike with limited modifications. Gateway to National licence.

classes.name: Formula 400
classes.notes: BMCRC class; 400cc four-cylinder production machines; popular budget class.

classes.name: Thunderbike
classes.notes: Club class; typically large-capacity V-twin / roadster machines; growing UK popularity.

classes.name: Supertwins / Super Twins
classes.notes: 650cc twin-cylinder class; popular in Irish road racing (NW200, TT) and UK club events.

classes.name: Classic / Historic (pre-1978)
classes.notes: CRMC-governed; pre-1978 machines in multiple vintage formula classes.

classes.name: Sidecar / Formula 2 Sidecar
classes.notes: UK sidecar racing under FSRA / ACU; Formula 2 and LCR classes.

classes.name: TT / IOM — Superbike
classes.notes: Senior TT blue riband class; 1000cc production-based. Separate ACU IOM licence and qualification required.

classes.name: TT / IOM — Supertwin
classes.notes: 650cc parallel-twin class; Kawasaki ER-6 and similar spec machines.

classes.name: TT Zero (Electric)
classes.notes: Electric motorcycle class at the Isle of Man TT; lap of the Mountain Course.
